items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: Dummy Corporation welcomes you off the factory floor. The cars are your colleagues; Certification is your goal.
items.trigger: ACT I · INDUCTION: the act line, on the district's first card and the map

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: Fresh off the factory floor, you're ready to do some damage to yourself. Make your engineers proud.
items.trigger: Monument A1 · The welcome wall: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: Battery 1 is fitted. The skybridge was built for shoppers who never came; staff watch you dash into a colleague.
items.trigger: Monument B1 · The podium bridge: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: The LED drum lights each bend. Step off the high road onto a car: gravity is company policy.
items.trigger: Monument C1 · The LED drum: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: The road runs through the portal tower at the sixth floor. Take your write-off up there; ignore the view.
items.trigger: Monument C2 · The portal tower: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: The plaque reads ZERO ACCIDENTS: a target, not a record. Stand near it until a colleague finds you.
items.trigger: Monument B2 · The monument: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: The neon shops sell nothing, but the traffic reads them. Hands 1 is fitted: bait a colleague with a cone.
items.trigger: Monument A2 · The neon shops: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: The stacked cubes rose one budget at a time. Build the same way: one hit, then another, quickly.
items.trigger: Monument A3 · The stacked cubes: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: Two screens advertise to each other all night. Legs 1 is fitted: jump into a car between them.
items.trigger: Monument B3 · The LED canyon: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: The gateway thanked the car that wrote you off for driving safely. Let one colleague throw you into the next.
items.trigger: Monument C3 · The LED gateway: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: The Expo opens to clients when this park passes. Your training keeps them safe.
items.trigger: ACT II · OPENING DAY: the act line, on the district's first card and the map

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: The lantern, the Expo's first exhibit, is lit for clients. With Arms 1, push off one car into the next.
items.trigger: Parkland C1 · The lantern pavilion: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: Our board watches opening day from these terraces. A van delivers the catering; arrange for it to deliver you.
items.trigger: Parkland C2 · The amphitheatre: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: The arch is the Expo's gate; visitors circle the roundabout once. You go faster: chain hits before each is forgotten.
items.trigger: Parkland C3 · The arch and the roundabout: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: The obelisk marks the surveyors' first stake. Police escort a school party here on opening day; test them first.
items.trigger: Parkland B3 · The obelisk court: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: A wedding faces the traffic from the belvedere. Legs 2 is fitted: jump into a car, so no guest does.
items.trigger: Parkland A3 · The belvedere: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: The dome is the Expo's showroom; you are the exhibit. Hands 2 is fitted: bait a car with a cone.
items.trigger: Parkland A2 · The dome by the canal: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: The gardener's pools need cars that stop. Teach them with Arms 2: push off one car into the next.
items.trigger: Parkland A1 · The reservoir terraces: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: The cascade was built to drown out the traffic. The traffic got louder; take your hit up on the highway.
items.trigger: Parkland B1 · The cascade: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: The board watches the ring over the pools. Battery 2 is fitted: chain your hits.
items.trigger: Parkland B2 · The ring over the pools: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: Certified dummies ship across the river, to be sacrificed in service to our clients. Your papers are being prepared.
items.trigger: ACT III · CUSTOMS: the act line, on the district's first card and the map

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: The bus carries engineers through the west portal to the bridge. It never misses; take its hit.
items.trigger: Waterfront A1 · The west portal: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: Cars go into the tunnel under the hill, and data comes back. Legs 3 is fitted: leap into one.
items.trigger: Waterfront B1 · The tunnel portal: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: The east portal faces away from its twin. Police here check papers; your Certification needs their fleet on record.
items.trigger: Waterfront C1 · The east portal: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: The east beach terrace served tourists, then sensors. Drop from its rail onto a car; ships wait for the Certified.
items.trigger: Waterfront C2 · The east beach terrace: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: The pier tower logs all that floats: containers, ducks, one dummy. Be thrown into a car to earn your entry.
items.trigger: Waterfront C3 · The east customs post: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: The stilt houses keep Chassis 0 behind glass. Arms 3 is fitted; push off a car and show it progress.
items.trigger: Waterfront B3 · The stilt houses: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: The west tower keeps the customs log. Your entry reads PURPOSE DESTRUCTION: honour it on the raised road.
items.trigger: Waterfront A3 · The west customs post: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: Sand from three provinces lies under the west beach terrace. Place a cone; one more clean reading before the ceremony.
items.trigger: Waterfront A2 · The west beach terrace: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: The circus monument, cast from your written-off chassis, reads ZERO ACCIDENTS (EXCLUDING TESTS). Battery 3 is fitted; chain your hits.
items.trigger: Waterfront B2 · The circus: the tile card's tale

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: Walk into the path of the incoming vehicles. Time your approach, and choose your angle carefully. Bonus points for combinations and lethal hits.
items.trigger: the brief 'any': the level card, the map's tile panel
items.label: ANY WRITE-OFF

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: Dash into a car. The final hit must be the dash.
items.trigger: the brief 'dash': the level card, the map's tile panel
items.label: DASH INTO A CAR

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: Drop onto a car from above. The final hit must be that drop.
items.trigger: the brief 'drop': the level card, the map's tile panel
items.label: DROP ONTO A CAR

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: Jump into a car. The jump must be the final hit.
items.trigger: the brief 'jump': the level card, the map's tile panel
items.label: JUMP INTO A CAR

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: Climb to a raised road. The final hit must land up there, not on the street.
items.trigger: the brief 'level': the level card, the map's tile panel
items.label: ON A RAISED ROAD

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: Place a cone. The final hit must come from a car reacting to it.
items.trigger: the brief 'cone': the level card, the map's tile panel
items.label: CONE-BAITED CAR

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: Push off one car. The final hit must be the next car.
items.trigger: the brief 'push': the level card, the map's tile panel
items.label: PUSH OFF A CAR

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: Let one car throw you into another. Take the final hit while a hit is still throwing you.
items.trigger: the brief 'bounce': the level card, the map's tile panel
items.label: THROWN INTO A CAR

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: Walk or stand in the traffic. A car must deliver the final hit while you are not dashing.
items.trigger: the brief 'struck': the level card, the map's tile panel
items.label: STRUCK, NOT DASHING

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: Chain your hits into a combo. The final hit must be link {n} or later.
items.trigger: the brief 'combo': the level card, the map's tile panel
items.label: COMBO ×{n}

items.speaker: Dummy Corporation
items.text: Step in front of the {clsLong}. The final hit must come from a {cls}.
items.trigger: the brief 'cls': the level card, the map's tile panel
items.label: A {cls}
